review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: The given bar graph illustrates how much money was used for investment area, by five organizations in 2010, labelled as A, B, C, D and E.

Overall, the amount of money allocated for spending sector by organization B was the most, while building received the highest investment in organizations B, D and E. Also of note is that, Staff Training cost the most in organization A, while an opposite was true in organization C.

To elaborate, In Organization B building had the highest figures, at approximately 1,7 billion euros, followed by research at around 1,5 billion euros. The figures for Research was higher than the three remaining organizations.

Regarding the remaining, organization A invested 1 billion euros in Staff Training, was highest figures in organization A; however, yet they remained worse the the figures for organization B. Finally, Organization B spent 0,8 billions euros on Machinery, which was significant higher than the figures for the other organizations.
review.overall: Em đã trình bày đủ bố cục, nêu đúng B đầu tư nhiều nhất, Building dẫn trong B/D/E và Staff Training đối lập A/C. Detail 1 chọn đúng Building–Research, Detail 2 chọn Staff Training–Machinery; các số 1,7, 1,5 và 1,0 là xấp xỉ hợp lý. Nhưng cuối bài em ghi Machinery B 0,8 tỷ, trái biểu đồ khoảng 1,3 tỷ. Điểm yếu khác nằm ở cách dựng câu: “The figures for Research was” sai hòa hợp, “organization A invested ... was highest” có hai vị ngữ thiếu nối, “however, yet” lặp quan hệ nhượng bộ và “significant higher” sai từ loại. Câu Research viết “three remaining organizations” dù ngoài B có bốn tổ chức. Em cần tự so lại cột Machinery B và viết lại những câu này.
review.learningVerdict: Đạt bố cục, cần sửa câu
